items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He can’t make any kind of sense. We go up there every – Alice and I go up every Christmas, at least.

ctx.x: I think that’s what Alice has said. That’s terrible, especially for someone who used his hands.
He can’t make any kind of sense. We go up there every – Alice and I go up every Christmas, at least.
